source_caption_text:
Y’all think DaBaby outrapped Cole on this one 👀⁉️

Dreamville’s “Under the Sun” brought together J. Cole, DaBaby and Lute for one of the standout tracks from the Revenge of the Dreamers III album. Over the soulful production, each rapper brings a different style, but Cole and DaBaby make a particularly strong impression with their verses.

J. Cole comes through with his smooth, controlled delivery and sharp writing, while DaBaby switches things up with his animated flow, punchlines and confident delivery. Their approaches are completely different, but both fit the beat in their own way. DaBaby brings a burst of energy to the track, while Cole keeps things grounded with his laid-back presence and wordplay.

The contrast between their verses is what makes the track so enjoyable to revisit. Both rappers make the most of their time on the song, leaving fans with a question that still makes for a good debate: who had the better verse? #dreamville 

#jcole #dababy #rap
